artifacts.title: Action (navy rounded)
artifacts.summary: Primary = solid navy-blue rounded rectangle (Chicago 45 #2E45B8, radius ~8px — live-observed CTA), white label; secondary = 2px ink outline; tertiary = underlined blue link (live-observed). Red steps back to brand/attention duty.

artifacts.title: Shape language (rounded product)
artifacts.summary: The live product uses soft rounded corners throughout: interactive components (buttons, toggles, inputs) and container surfaces (cards, panels) all carry radius ~8. Only rules, hairlines and editorial glyph marks stay crisp — no square buttons, no square cards.

artifacts.title: Motion
artifacts.summary: Interaction transitions are near-instant (≤0.15s colour swaps); no bounce, spring or decorative movement in UI chrome. Motion stays native to brand assets, not interface controls.

artifacts.title: Typography (three registers)
artifacts.summary: Three registers by role: Serif = headlines and body text; Sans = navigation, metadata, datelines, captions; Sans Headline = display-only moments (page mastheads, big statics), used sparingly.

artifacts.title: Screen type scale
artifacts.summary: Screen rhythm: serif headline 30–34/1.15; standfirst sans? no — serif standfirst 16–17 muted; body serif 17/1.55; metadata sans 12.5–13 with 0.06em caps for section labels; display 44 at tracking −1.

artifacts.title: Colour roles (red + Chicago blue)
artifacts.summary: Red #E3120B = brand/editorial punctuation (labels, rules, single blocks). The Chicago blue family = the interactive layer (CTAs, active nav, links) — copious, per live review. Frame: ink, white, London grey ramp.

artifacts.title: Surfaces & separation
artifacts.summary: White ground; separation via 2px ink rules and hairlines below (wash separation removed per review). Elevation, where needed, uses defined shadow tokens — not ambient glows.

artifacts.title: Section rhythm
artifacts.summary: Section label (sans caps, red) → serif headline → one-line standfirst (muted serif). Repeats strictly; no decorative sub-heads.

artifacts.title: Top bar
artifacts.summary: Top bar: white, 2px ink bottom rule; name in serif left; sans links; active = blue underline (Chicago 45) per review; crisp search rectangle with typing-cursor motif right.

artifacts.title: Field (rounded, sans text)
artifacts.summary: Fields: white, 1px soft border, rounded corners (radius 8), sans-serif field text (reviewer-directed); label above in caps; focus adds no border highlight; error = small red line under the field.

a11y: <label for> always; focus visible by other means if border highlight is suppressed.

artifacts.title: Notice (ruled box)
artifacts.summary: Notices = ruled boxes (2px ink top or left rule) with terse declarative copy; no toasts (none evidenced); problem copy names the fact and the next step.

artifacts.title: Progress meter
artifacts.summary: Progress = crisp rectangle track (London 85) with red fill; readout as sans metadata ('7 of 10 steps'); restart = outline rectangle. Static updates only.

artifacts.title: Data charts (rectilinear register)
artifacts.summary: Charts are rectilinear and editorial: ink bars on hairline baselines (2px ink origin rule, grey/ink gridlines), a month grid of square cells, and a hairline sparkline. Red appears only as a single accent; no rings, no decorative chart styling.

body.geometry: rectilinear only - bar columns, matrix/calendar cells, ruled axes; no circular gauges or rings (rectangles are the geometry; the demo's completion ring was an app-spec extrapolation - completion readouts use the meter/readout family instead)
body.palette: Chicago-blue family and the city accent palettes carry data series (the documented data/section role); Economist Red is the single attention mark (today/target), never a series colour; London grey ramp for tracks and neutral fills
body.grid: hairline rules/gridlines (London 85) - rules do the separating; no zebra, no box grids, no shadows
body.typography: sans for numbers and labels (metadata register); serif for chart titles
body.in_character: newspaper furniture: rules, ordered columns, one red mark per chart

checks: chart markup uses no rounded or circular marks (geometry check)
series colours are drawn only from the city palettes, with red appearing at most as a single attention mark (token check)
chart numerals use the sans register (type check)

artifacts.title: Data readouts (sparkline trend, stat counter)
artifacts.summary: Big statics: an Archivo (display) numeral with a sans-caps label beneath; reserved for year-to-date totals and headline counts.

body.sparkline: mini rectilinear columns in Chicago blue over the London ramp; no axes; static; sits at metadata scale
body.stat: display-face numeral (display 44, tracking -1) + sans-caps label; used sparingly - one display moment per screen; streak counts qualify
body.excluded: no rings or gauges, no motion, no emoji/sparkle
body.in_character: a single loud numeral against quiet apparatus - restraint, not dashboard chrome

checks: at most one display-face numeral per screen (spec check)
no radial geometry is used for trends or counters (geometry check)

artifacts.title: Tag (status / category)
artifacts.summary: Tags: ink-outline caps rectangle (8px radius); attention flips it solid red; never a pill, never colour-alone.

body.mark: rounded ~8 surface (per L-02 v4 and rule L-R1) with a 2px ink outline; uppercase sans 11, 0.06em tracking; strictly one line
body.attention: attention states turn the tag solid red with a white word; positive states keep the ink outline
body.rules: no pills, no dots as sole signal (L-13)
body.in_character: a stamped word, not a bubble; taxonomy stays quiet

checks: tag markup is not pill or full-round (radius check against the ~8 system radius)
attention state = solid red + white word; no dot-only status variant exists (spec check)
tag type is uppercase sans at <=11px with letter-spacing present (type check)
